text.body:
lakṣmīnṛsiṃha lalanām jagatosyanetrīm mātṛsvabhāva mahitām haritulya śīlām lokasya maṅgalakarīm ramaṇīya rūpām padmālayām bhagavatīm śaraṇam prapadye ॥ 1॥
śrīyādanāmakamunīṃdratapoviśeṣāt śrīyādaśailaśikhare satata prakāśau bhaktānurāgabharitau bhavaroga vaidyau lakṣmīnṛsiṃha caraṇau śaraṇam prapadye ॥ 2॥
devasvarūpa vikṛtāvapinaijarupau sarvottarau sujana saru niśevyamānau sarvasya jīvanakarau sadrṛśasvarūpau lakṣmīnṛsiṃha caraṇau śaraṇam prapadye ॥ 3॥
lakṣmīśate prapadane sahakārabhūtau tvattopyati priyatamau śaraṇāgatānām rakṣāvicakṣaṇa paṭū karuṇālayau śrī lakṣmīnṛsiṃha caraṇau śaraṇam prapadye ॥ 4॥
prahlāda pautra balidānava bhūmidāna kālaprakāśita nijānya jaghanya bhāvau lokapramāṇa karaṇau śubhadau surānām lakṣmīnṛsiṃha caraṇau śaraṇam prapadye ॥ 5॥
kāyādavīya śubhamānasa rājahaṃsau vedānta kalpataru pallava ṭalli jautau sadbhakta mūladhanamityudita prabhāvau lakṣmīnṛsiṃha caraṇau śaraṇam prapadye ॥ 6॥
॥ iti śrī vaṃgīpuram narasiṃhācārya viracitaṃ śrī yādagiri lakṣmīnṛsiṃha prapattiḥ samāptaṃ ॥
